t: You're on Old Burlington Street in Westminster, a street on land that was once part of the Burlington Estate. Three notable people died here. Studholme Hodgson was a Field Marshal who fought at Fontenoy and Culloden, and commanded the expedition that captured Belle Île in 1761. John Hulke was a surgeon, geologist and fossil collector. Sir John Call was an engineer and politician. Beyond that, the material I have is thin, so I'll leave the street itself for you to take in.
